notes.title: True or False Launches September 16th
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26098736/59aa82ccd193d09edec44a0b19fdc0ea6c7ac137.jpg[/img]

Hello all, 

Thank you for the patience! 

True or False is scheduled to launch on [b]September 16, 2016[/b], so I thought we’d take a look at the post-release content plans for the game.

In the months following launch, all the players will be handed at least one free DLC:
[list]
[*] Silver September DLC, which is scheduled to launch by the end of September and will include up to 100 additional facts.
[/list]
Depending on the players' reception of the game, there might be several more free content updates:
[list]
[*] October DLC, which will include additional facts available to all players;
[*] November DLC, which will include additional facts available to all players;
[*] Expansion Pack's Update, which will include more exclusive facts available to Expansion Pack's owners.
[/list]
But that's not all! 

There is a growing interest in adding even more facts among the game's followers. Starting today, I'm accepting your own facts on Steam Discussions. When there would be enough facts collected, they would be released as a free DLC available to all of the players by the end of the autumn.

That's it for now. Hope you all have a fantastic week!
